INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

2. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing – Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
